reviewer_record.feature: Type 2 axial shading parameters, defaults, and paint bounds
reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:5831-5852 (Table 77 Background/BBox), 5884-5915 (Type 2 and Table 79); source PDF printed pp. 233-234. Table 79 Domain default [0 1], Extend default [false false]; Domain maps axis fraction into Function input; each Extend boolean independently admits t outside [0,1]. Table 77 BBox is an additional temporary clip in target space; Background fills pattern area outside shading bounds only when used by a shading pattern, and is ignored by sh.
reviewer_record.errata: Effective ISO 32000-2:2020(E) consolidated with EC3 checked; no Type 2/Table 77 amendment identified in the errata index. EC3 consolidated source retains these defaults and separate producer constraints.
reviewer_record.code: pdf-colour/src/shading.rs::domain/extend/ramp/axial; pdf-render/src/shading.rs::Ramp/axial bounds/painting_bounds; render backend ramp paths and shading clip.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Public pixels prove endpoint/midpoint ramp, perpendicular invariance, explicit false-vs-true extension, axial BBox clipping, and pattern-only Background with/without entry. Default Domain [0,1] and default Extend [false,false] are used by fixtures that omit those keys. Ramp sampling has an independent pixel-center oracle. Scratch exact-xref draft uses Domain [0.2,0.8] and predicts the quarter-axis linear ramp is about 89/255, distinguishing ignored Domain (~64); unrun.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for standard default axial Domain/Extend, independent endpoint extension, common BBox clip, and pattern Background condition.
reviewer_record.residuals: No promoted axial pixel oracle uses non-unit shading Domain. The scratch draft adds an axial non-unit Domain pixel control but is unrun. Type 2 indexed color-space prohibition is a producer constraint, not an automatic reader-error assertion.

reviewer_record.feature: Type 3 radial shading parameters, defaults, and paint bounds
reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:5831-5852 (Table 77), 5917-5975 (Type 3, Table 80 and Notes 1-3); source PDF printed pp. 235-237. Table 80 Domain default [0,1], Extend default [false,false]; radii shall be nonnegative; zero radii are points and both zero means nothing paints. A smaller extended end stops at radius zero; a larger extended end continues until it covers BBox. The pixel color is the greatest admissible s among enclosing circles.
reviewer_record.errata: Effective ISO 32000-2:2020(E) consolidated with EC3 checked; no Type 3/Table 80 amendment identified in the errata index.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Public pixels check the ramp between concentric circles, non-extended outside transparency, equal-radius symmetry, pattern Background for nested-circle and cone cases, plus direct greatest-root/cone and backend agreement assertions. Default Domain/Extend are omitted in the radial pixel fixtures. Scratch exact-xref draft uses the same non-unit Domain at radial s≈0.25 and predicts about 89/255, distinguishing ignored Domain (~64); unrun.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for sampled concentric shading, default non-extension, nested/cone Background bounds, and greatest-admissible-root logic.
reviewer_record.residuals: No promoted radial pixel oracle uses non-unit shading Domain or asymmetric Extend combinations at both ends. Scratch adds the non-unit Domain radial pixel control but it is unrun. Radius-zero termination, both-zero no-paint, BBox-capped large-end extension, and anti-aliased zero-area BBox are not covered by sampled tests. Indexed color-space prohibition is producer-facing.

reviewer_record.feature: Common shading BBox and pattern-only Background
reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:5831-5852; source PDF printed pp. 230-234. BBox is a target-space temporary clip in addition to current and other clips; zero height/width still paints one pixel (cross-reference §10.7.4). Background is applied before pattern shading, only for shading-pattern use, and must be an appropriate color-space component array.
reviewer_record.errata: No applicable EC3 correction to Table 77 identified; effective consolidated source reviewed.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: BBox uses public alpha pixels for inside/outside and path intersection. Pattern Background tests compare the same in-area/out-of-bounds point with and without Background; separate sh test confirms ignored entry and no report. Axial/radial bound semantics determine outside points separately from shared BBox clipping.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for ordinary nondegenerate BBox clip and Background routing in sampled geometry types.
reviewer_record.residuals: No sampled zero-width/height BBox one-pixel fixture; mesh-specific BBox and all backend implementations are not independently established by the cited axial BBox assertion alone.
